summary: This Form 6-K filed May 7, 2026, reports QMMM Holdings Ltd.'s appointment of Ms. Yung-Shan Hsiao as an independent director, audit committee chair, and compensation/nominating committee member, effective immediately. The board determined she qualifies as independent under SEC/Nasdaq rules and as an audit committee financial expert. Her annual cash compensation is US$18,000. The filing is a routine non-special-situation disclosure of a board composition change with formal appointment terms, no shareholder meeting context or mandated departure. No deal terms apply. This is a standard director appointment, not a forced departure.
